name: app-oviah-ui-elements-buttons-inputs-nav-calendar-states
title: OVIAH UI elements sheet: button, input, checkbox, navigation and calendar states in lilac
whatItIs: A white 'UI Elements' page documenting component states: primary/secondary buttons (default/pressed), input fields (default, focus, error, success), a checkbox (default/pressed), a header and footer spec, a bottom navigation bar with an active-tab highlight, and a calendar in default and date-selected states.
whatItMeans: Systematic and implementation-ready; documenting every state removes guesswork for whoever builds the app.
techniques: Document each component in every interactive state.
Colour-code input feedback (red for error, green for success).
Show the same calendar twice to contrast default and selected.

vocabulary.definition: A variant of a UI element for a specific condition.
A visual marker showing the current navigation section.
